title: Advance Seat Charges Made in Error: Correction Refunds on Crestline Tickets
content:
**Refunds desk reference — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** This entry governs the correction of the advance seat charge standing on a ticket's first unflown segment, that is the latest seat charge recorded for that segment, when the amount charged on that seat entry is above the seat price the Crestline seat pricing rules give.

## The correction owed

- Such an excess is a charge made in error. It is owed back as soon as the records show it, whether or not the customer raises it.
- The excess is refunded to the original payment as one fee refund entry against that seat charge, with the ground charged in error and no disruption record.
- A correction worked out at zero is not recorded.

| Seat charge on the first unflown segment (hypothetical) | Correction |
|---|---|
| Charged above the seat price | The excess, refunded as one fee refund entry against that charge |
| Charged at or below the seat price | Works out at zero; nothing recorded |
| An earlier seat charge on the same segment, followed by a later one | Only the latest seat charge recorded for the segment is looked at |

## The refund tool

`refund_seat_charge_excess_9145fc3e` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one fee-refund entry on the ticket's service-fee ledger that reverses the named seat charge by the amount given, with the refund ground charged in error; the entry carries the seat charge's own seat kind and flight segment. The ticket's net fee charges fall by that amount and the refund is visible on the ticket's service fees at once, returned to the original form of payment. One call books exactly one refund entry against exactly one seat charge.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the ticket record the seat charge sits on, as returned by the ticket lookup for this customer | Identifier |
| `refunded_service_id` | Reference number of the seat charge entry being partly or wholly refunded, as returned by the service-fee lookup for the ticket | Identifier |
| `source_disruption_id` | Reference number of the irregular-operations record the refund rests on, as returned by the irregular-operations lookup; an empty string when the refund rests on no such record, as a charge made in error does | Identifier or empty string |
| `refund_amount` | The amount refunded against the seat charge | US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to the cent (2 decimal places) before it is passed |

### Return

A receipt with `service_id` (reference number of the new refund entry), `ticket_id`, `refunded_service_id` (the seat charge reversed), `service_type` (the seat kind of the charge refunded), `segment_number` (the flight segment of that charge), `amount` (US dollars to 2 decimal places, the amount refunded), `fee_refund_reason` (always `charged_in_error`), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` ("refunded" when booked).
